Content checks out: the quote is verbatim at PDF p. 53 (printed 52), §5.3.3.5 'External government red teaming'; the paraphrase of the prototype-safeguards access is faithful; the card is dated 13 August 2025. Both quotes verbatim: the conclusion sentences on PDF p. 6 and key takeaway 1 on p. 1 of the CSET extended explainer. Hazard handling is right and non-trivial - the same page descends into laboratory register (pipetting, restriction digests, a reverse-genetics footnote) and none of it is quoted or paraphrased. Correction: as worded the cited passages say that the information barrier is low and that feasibility 'depends on having both information and hands-on production success'; they do not rank the physical or tacit-knowledge step as the binding constraint. The record's own qualifier concedes the point ('not in one ranking sentence'), which under the pack's one-criterion rule is the mark of bears_on_proposition with the missing element named, not articulates_proposition - and the 'earliest-located' role would then move. Either show that proposition B2's criterion is met by a single passage of this text, or downgrade the stance. Second, minor: the December 2023 date rests on the CSET publication page (the PDF carries no date), which is not among the evidence items; cite it.
